pull.title: rpc: fix dumptxoutset rollback crash after loadtxoutset on pruned node
pull.body:
On a pruned node, `dumptxoutset` with `rollback` checks that the blocks it needs haven't been pruned by calling `GetFirstBlock(*current_tip, BLOCK_HAVE_MASK)` (blockchain.cpp:3194). `GetFirstBlock` asserts that the block it starts from has both block and undo data (blockstorage.cpp:638).

Right after `loadtxoutset`, the active tip is the snapshot base block, and that has neither until it's downloaded. So on a `-prune` node:

```
loadtxoutset <snapshot>
dumptxoutset <path> rollback=<height>
```

aborts bitcoind:

```
Assertion failed: ((last_block->nStatus & status_mask) == status_mask), function GetFirstBlock, file blockstorage.cpp, line 638.
```

The `GetPruneHeight` helper already guards against a tip without data (blockchain.cpp:934), this call site doesn't.

This returns an RPC error ("Could not roll back to requested height since block data for the current tip is not available.") when the tip itself has no data, before calling `GetFirstBlock`. The check runs for every node, not only in prune mode: without `-prune` the same scenario doesn't abort, but it would otherwise copy the whole UTXO set into a temporary database before failing with an internal error. The existing "already pruned" error is still returned when `GetFirstBlock` finds a gap.

The test goes in `feature_assumeutxo.py`: right after the snapshot is loaded on the pruned node (node 1), and again on the non-pruned node 2, `dumptxoutset` with a rollback to the start height must return that error. On master the pruned node aborts and the RPC connection drops (RemoteDisconnected). With the fix `feature_assumeutxo.py` and `rpc_dumptxoutset.py` pass.

rpc: fix dumptxoutset rollback crash after loadtxoutset on pruned node

On a pruned node, dumptxoutset with rollback calls GetFirstBlock on the
active chain tip to check that the needed block data hasn't been
pruned. GetFirstBlock asserts that the block it starts from has block
and undo data. Right after loadtxoutset the active tip is the snapshot
base block, which has neither until it is downloaded, so the call
aborts bitcoind:

  Assertion failed: ((last_block->nStatus & status_mask) == status_mask),
  function GetFirstBlock, file blockstorage.cpp

Return the existing "necessary block data is already pruned" error when
the tip itself has no data.

rpc: use a dedicated error when the tip has no block data

The "already pruned" error is misleading when the tip is the snapshot
base block right after loadtxoutset: nothing was pruned, the block just
has not been downloaded yet.

events.body: Agreed it's unlikely to be hit in practice. The reason I still think it's worth fixing is that it's an RPC call aborting the node instead of returning an error, and the fix is just a status check before GetFirstBlock. If you think it's not worth the review time I'm fine closing it.

One question: the new tip check is only inside `if (IsPruneMode())`. Without `-prune` the same scenario does not crash the node, but it copies the whole UTXO set into a temporary LevelDB and then fails with `-32603`. Why not check the tip for any rollback, before the copy?

tested ACK 8fa8ed01119d32536862c385c7286e588b1bfdd0
- Linux x86_64, gcc 13.3, Release build
- PR test on merge-base ed7dd7cf4e15 and on master aef8a04966d7: fails with RemoteDisconnected; node1 aborts with SIGABRT, assert in GetFirstBlock (blockstorage.cpp:638)
- PR head, and PR merged onto master (merge is clean): feature_assumeutxo.py and rpc_dumptxoutset.py pass, the node stays up
- pruned node without a snapshot: rollback still works; after pruneblockchain the "already pruned" error is still returned
- nit: description is stale: it still says the existing "already pruned" error is returned, and that master times out (the connection drops right away)

rpc: check the dumptxoutset rollback tip data on non-pruned nodes too

Without -prune the missing tip data is only found after the UTXO set has been copied into a temporary database, and the RPC then fails with an internal error. Check it before the copy for every node.

events.body: Thanks, good point. I moved the tip check out of the `IsPruneMode()` block in 7c7a482ce5, so it now runs for every node before the UTXO set is copied. The test now also covers the non-pruned node (n2) right after `loadtxoutset`. I also updated the description: the connection drops right away on master rather than timing out, and the "already pruned" error is only returned when `GetFirstBlock` finds a gap.
